title: 第474章 原来是哥布林
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

二人穿过街道，避开往来的人群。

直接从侧门绕到奇妙物语商铺的后院厨房。

“怎么带我来厨房了？”

林奇看着四周堆放的柴火与厨具，眼底升起几分疑惑。

就在这时，柴堆旁忽然传来一阵沉闷的挣扎声。

“唔！唔！”

林奇扭头望去。

只见柴垛旁捆着一名粗犷壮汉。

看起来大概三十五六岁，身形高大，皮肉结实。

此刻被一根牛筋绳捆住手脚，口中塞着抹布，只能用喉咙发出含糊的闷响。

“这个人来店里售卖宁神花，数量十分庞大。”

杰克拿出一张储物卡递给林奇。

“我问他货源是怎么来的，他死活不说，我便出手擒下他，把他关到了这里。”

“大量宁神花？”

林奇心里咯噔一下，

连忙接过储卡，查探起了其中的数量。

一万多张封印卡，每一张都封印着一朵宁神花。

封印卡的售价是100卡恩一张，宁神花的售价现在已经涨到700卡恩一朵。

若是这宁神花是其他人养殖售卖的，不可能浪费这么多张封印卡。

甚至是奇妙物语商铺，也不会将宁神花封印到卡牌中售卖。

因为对于奇妙物语商铺来说，宁神花的成本价格极低，仅有几卡恩，远远不如封印卡珍贵。

用封印卡批量封存宁神花，是他之前特意嘱咐布鲁斯做的，只为了方便他后续融卡。

现在看到这储物卡内的宁神花，林奇已经明白，为什么布鲁斯的车队拖延了这么多天还没有到达的原因。

“杰克，把他松开。”

林奇声音平静，盯着那个男人。

杰克上前，一把拽出壮汉口中的抹布。

“咳咳咳……”

壮汉剧烈咳嗽两声，刚重获开口的机会，眼底心中怒意瞬间爆发，张口便是怒骂。

“你个狗东西！敢拿脏东西堵老子的嘴，信不信老子弄死你？”

“啪！”

杰克也不惯他，抬手便是一记清脆响亮的耳光。

力道十足，直接将壮汉半边脸扇得红肿发麻。

“你最好认清楚现在的形势，能不能活着，可不是由你能决定的。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The two walked across the street, avoiding the passing crowds.

Go directly from the side door to the backyard kitchen of the Wonderful Story store.

"Why did you bring me to the kitchen?"

Lin Qi looked at the firewood and kitchen utensils piled around, with some doubts in his eyes.

At this moment, a dull sound of struggling suddenly came from next to the firewood pile.

"Uh! Uh!"

Lynch turned to look.

I saw a rough and strong man tied up next to the firewood pile.

He looks to be about thirty-five or sixteen years old, tall and muscular.

At this moment, his hands and feet were tied up with a tendon rope, and a rag was stuffed in his mouth. He could only make muffled noises from his throat.

"This man came to the store to sell Ningshen flowers, and the quantity was very large."

Jack took out a storage card and handed it to Lynch.

"I asked him how he got the supply, but he refused to tell me whether he was alive or dead, so I captured him and locked him up here."

"A lot of Ningshenhua?"

Lin Qi's heart skipped a beat.

He quickly took the storage card and checked the quantity inside.

There are more than 10,000 sealing cards, each one sealed with a Ningshen Flower.

The price of the seal card is 100 Karns, and the price of the Ningshen Flower has now increased to 700 Karns.

If this Ningshen Flower was cultivated and sold by others, it would be impossible to waste so many seal cards.

Even the Wonderful Story store will not seal the Ningshen Flower into cards for sale.

Because for the Wonderful Story store, the cost of the Ningshen Flower is extremely low, only a few Karns, which is far less valuable than the Sealed Card.

Using seal cards to seal the Ningshen Flower in batches was what he had specifically asked Bruce to do before, just to facilitate his subsequent card fusion.

Now seeing the Ningshen Flower in the storage card, Lynch already understood the reason why Bruce's convoy had not arrived for so many days.

"Jack, let him go."

Lynch's voice was calm and he stared at the man.

Jack stepped forward and pulled the rag out of the strong man's mouth.

"Cough cough cough..."

The strong man coughed twice violently, and as soon as he regained the chance to speak, the anger in his eyes suddenly burst out, and he opened his mouth to curse.

"You bitch! If you dare to block my mouth with dirty things, do you believe I will kill you?"

"Crack!"

Jack didn't like him either, so he raised his hand and gave him a clear and resounding slap.

It was so powerful that half of the strong man's face was slapped red, swollen and numb.

"You'd better understand the current situation clearly. Whether you can survive or not is not up to you."
